运行时按需加载的库（未随仓库分发）/ Runtime-optional library (not bundled)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------

SheetJS Community Edition (xlsx) v0.20.3 — Apache License 2.0
   https://git.sheetjs.com/sheetjs/sheetjs
   仅在用户上传 .xlsx/.xls 文件时，从官方 CDN
   https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js
   动态加载。本仓库不分发该文件。
   Using version 0.20.3 because it contains the fixes for CVE-2023-30533
   (fixed in 0.19.3) and CVE-2024-22363 (fixed in 0.20.2). The npm-published
   `xlsx` package stops at 0.18.5 and never received those fixes.
